fixes.explanation: Wind and darkness, friend? Not this time. This sky was loud and flashing, nobody was sitting around in the dark. The text says the LORD sent "…thunder and hail, and lightning struck the earth." (Exodus 9:23) Thunder and lightning are what came with the hail.

problems.problem: The junk drawer joke doesn't fit the comparison: a quiet drawer may be dark, but nothing connects it to wind.
